svg.title: Training order
svg.desc: tools/train_all.sh trains the flow encoder and exports an embedding for every event; exports flow records and trains the record encoder; trains the detection encoder and the detector heads; trains the forecasting encoder, then the lag tag's compressor, latents, world model and calibration; then the live tag's compressor, latents, world model and calibration on the detection encoder; writes serving.json and the tolerance reports; records the run and promotes it to artifacts/current.
